primary.notes: Some pendants have colored threads introduced during the plying, producing a change of color down the length of the string.  This is not a spike.  The threads are camelid with vivid red.

cords.name: p1
cords.notes: This cord is not attached to the primary cord, but is placed at the beginning.

cords.name: p33
cords.notes: Cord #34 may be a subsidiary of this cord starting at 1.5 cm.
